# SPD-053 — PR landing: the auto-mode permission classifier refuses Spud's gh pr merge (Merge Without Review), so Eric merges by hand

## Brief
Eric's standing call (2026-09-14, SPD-014 question 3) is that Spud merges a PR-landing project's pull request himself once the required checks pass. On BAD-001 (PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/329) the auto-mode permission classifier refused Spud's `gh pr merge` as "Merge Without Review", and Eric merged by hand.

Find what makes the merge allowed without weakening review in general: an allow rule `project install` writes into the project's untracked settings (for example `Bash(gh pr merge *)`), GitHub auto-merge enabled by Spud when the PR opens, or another sanctioned route; and whether the classifier respects any of them. If none is acceptable, the landing step in CLAUDE.md says Eric merges and Spud records the ticket done after the merge.

Done when: a BadTakes PR with green checks lands without Eric's hand, or CLAUDE.md and the merge memory say plainly that Eric merges.

## Size, persona and model decision
A researcher on opus (no Fable today) to find the sanctioned way to let Spud merge a PR with green checks, or to record that Eric merges; then an engineer or a CLAUDE.md edit.

## Handoffs
- 2026-09-14 — Charlotte (01) → Spud: The spike and its route: Eric names the landing in his opening prompt and the classifier's stated-intent tier allows the merge; Spud edits CLAUDE.md and the merge memory, and puts the hands-free allow rule and the required-checks proposal to Eric

## Proposals received
- **Never retry a classifier refusal, in any project, for any category** — origin [[SPUD-053/Charlotte]] — decision: declined: Spud-only work, so no ticket: the never-retry rule goes into CLAUDE.md's Landing bullet under SPD-053, in the same edit that records the stated-intent route.
- **Make smoke and test required status checks on BadTakes main, alongside Gate** — origin [[SPUD-053/Charlotte]] — decision: declined: Already the case since BAD-022: Gate is a job inside ci.yml that needs changes, test and smoke with always(), so a red test or smoke fails the one required context, while requiring them directly would strand docs-only PRs whose gated jobs skip; the premise that Gate alone is thin is wrong.

## Outcome
Charlotte's spike (docs/spikes/2026-09-14-pr-merge-in-auto-mode.md) found the sanctioned route: the classifier's documented stated-intent tier allows a PR merge when Eric's own message in the session asked for it (6 of 6 allowed after he asked, 6 of 20 without; PR 337 refused, then allowed byte for byte after 'Do the merge for me'). Auto-merge, a label-driven Actions merge and landing outside auto mode were rejected with evidence. Eric chose the hands-free escalation on 2026-09-14: his own line Bash(gh pr merge:*) in permissions.allow of BadTakes' .claude/settings.local.json, which resolves the merge before the classifier and which project install leaves alone; the line is his to write, never Spud's. CLAUDE.md's Landing bullet and the merge memory record both routes, the never-retry rule and the ban on manufacturing intent. Verification runs on the next BadTakes PRs: five first-attempt landings in a row, each landing's report entry saying whether the rule was in force.
